note: Loan books concentrated in fossil fuel extraction, coal power, and heavy industry face impairment as carbon pricing tightens and demand shifts. NZBA sectoral targets require phase-down plans.

topic: Physical risk exposure in real estate book
note: Commercial and residential mortgage portfolios exposed to flood, wildfire, and sea-level rise. TCFD scenario analysis required for material exposures.

topic: Stranded-asset risk in fossil fuel equities
note: Equity and fixed-income holdings in oil, gas, and coal companies subject to reserve write-downs under IEA Net Zero scenarios. SFDR PAI 4 disclosure driver.
Principal Adverse Impact statements, pre-contractual disclosures, and periodic reporting under SFDR Level 2 RTS require extensive data collection from investee companies.
Moving from PCAF data quality score 4-5 (sector averages) to score 1-2 (verified company data) requires investee engagement, data vendor contracts, and internal tooling.

topic: Green bond and sustainability-linked loan opportunity
note: Growing demand for EU Green Bond Standard-compliant issuances and sustainability-linked loans with credible KPIs. Fee income and AUM growth opportunity.

topic: Climate litigation risk from investee companies
note: Investee companies facing climate litigation (e.g., Milieudefensie v. Shell, ClientEarth v. board directors) create contingent liability and reputational risk for shareholders.
Government bonds of climate-vulnerable nations face credit deterioration from physical impacts (SIDS, Sub-Saharan Africa). PCAF sovereign debt methodology applies.
Residential mortgage portfolios with collateral in flood-prone areas face LTV deterioration and insurance gap widening. ECB climate stress test driver.
Scarcity of ESG analysts, climate risk modellers, and sustainable finance specialists. Talent retention critical for SFDR compliance and product development.
